title: Arcane Scribe at Work
description: A hooded wizard in a starry blue robe sits at a slanted black desk, writing with a quill that emits green smoke onto glowing blue parchment. Floating above him are multiple burning magical scrolls and papers with symbols, set in a stone room with an aurora visible through the window.
prompt: A hooded wizard wearing a deep blue starry robe sits at a large black slanted desk in an ancient stone study, leaning forward and writing with a large quill pen that emits green mystical smoke onto glowing blue parchment covered in golden symbols, multiple enchanted papers and scrolls with runes and diagrams floating in the air above him with purple flames and sparks, an aurora borealis visible through a tall window on the left, various magical items like a compass, magnifying glass, and glowing potion jars scattered around, detailed fantasy illustration in rich atmospheric colors
